name: PdG_converter
description: Converts urine PdG (pregnanediol glucuronide) measurements to progesterone equivalents using fitted mathematical models. Supports kink (broken-stick) and linear models with bounded least squares fitting. Features individual per-animal parameter storage and optional plugin architecture.
